title: Acyclicity of a tabulated instruction gadget
statement: Let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $F$ assign a list of Boolean outputs to each instruction kind and input list, let $z$ be a list of Boolean values, and let $i$ and $\mathrm{ins}$ be an instruction index and instruction. The gate list constructed for this instruction is acyclic relative to its tabulated base offset.
